'''Dave Ryan'''<ref name="dt-19309">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19309 HDADTJ racing deck], DeckTech (Dave "phishpage" Ryan, 11 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19309/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19309/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''phishpage'''<ref name="gpn-173">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=173 HB swarm deck], Game Players Network (phishpage, 8 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. Ryan also published one constructed list on [[Game Players Network]] in December 2001.
